description.value: Janevca is a fine dining restaurant housed in a heritage building in Victoria's Esquimalt neighbourhood, built around a team of seasoned culinary professionals including an award-winning Red Seal pastry chef and a sommelier with over 30 years of experience at establishments such as The Ritz Carlton Montreal and Hôtel Westminster Paris. The menu takes a dynamic, seasonal approach and the beverage program is curated to pair precisely with each dish. A lounge and veranda provide a walk-in-friendly alternative to the reservation-only main dining room.
